```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (child)*>
  <!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % pe "<!-- parameter entity comment --> <!ENTITY ent 'entity-value'>">
  %pe;
  <?target-pi data="processing-instruction-value"?>
]>
<root xmlns="http://example.com/ns1" xmlns:ns2="http://example.com/ns2" ns2:attr="value">
  <!-- Main structural comment -->
  <?custom-pi test="1"?>
  <child>&ent;</child>
  <ns2:child>
    <![CDATA[ CDATA block with <tags> & entities inside ]]&ent;>
  </ns2:child>
</root>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE testDoc [
  <!ELEMENT testDoc (item+)>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY base "Root Entity">
  <!ENTITY nested "&base; Extended">
  <!ENTITY % extEnt SYSTEM "http://example.com/ext.dtd">
  %extEnt;
  <?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="style.xsl"?>
]>
<testDoc xmlns="http://default.ns" xmlns:ext="http://extension.ns">
  <!-- Test comment explaining validation rules -->
  <?target data="val"?>
  <ext:item id="1">
    <![CDATA[
      Some raw CDATA text with arbitrary characters: <>&'"
    ]]>
  </ext:item>
  <item>&nested;</item>
</testDoc>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE document [
  <!ELEMENT document (section)*>
  <!ELEMENT section (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY author "Jane Doe">
  <!ENTITY copyright "Copyright 2023 &author;">
  <?xml-compound-pi target="config" data="status=active"?>
]>
<document xmlns="http://doc.org/ns" xmlns:meta="http://doc.org/meta" meta:version="2.0">
  <!-- Document level comment -->
  <?meta:processing instruction="load"?>
  <meta:header>
    <![CDATA[
      Nested CDATA content.
      Should handle <tags>, &, quotes ('") safely.
    ]]>
  </meta:header>
  <section>©right;</section>
</document>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (book*)>
  <!ELEMENT book (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY pub "Global Publishing">
  <!ENTITY % internalDtd "
    <!ELEMENT price (#PCDATA)>
  ">
  %internalDtd;
  <?catalog-info dept="tech"?>
]>
<catalog xmlns="http://catalog.org/ns" xmlns:bk="http://catalog.org/ns/book">
  <!-- Catalog section comment -->
  <?bk:action refresh="true"?>
  <book id="b1">
    <![CDATA[
      Book description CDATA section.
      Contains XML-like structures: <book> & </book>.
    ]]>
  </book>
  <bk:details>Published by &pub;</bk:details>
</catalog>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE config [
  <!ELEMENT config (param*)>
  <!ELEMENT param (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY default-val "enabled">
  <!ENTITY override-val "&default-val;-strict">
  <?app-init mode="debug"?>
]>
<config xmlns="http://app.org/config" xmlns:sys="http://app.org/sys" sys:active="true">
  <!-- Configuration file root comment -->
  <?sys-log level="info" dest="stdout"?>
  <sys:setting>
    <![CDATA[
      System configuration details:
      Param A: <on>
      Param B: &override-val;
    ]]>
  </sys:setting>
  <param>&override-val;</param>
</config>
```
